dialogues.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
dialogues.text: It's those paintings you see on cliffs, walls, and the ground everywhere here in Natlan. It's our local art form, and it's only popular here!

dialogues.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
dialogues.text: Huh? Feels like I've seen you somewhere before! I can't quite remember where, though... Wonder if that's a residual effect of the accident before.

dialogues.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
dialogues.text: I was painting a cliffside when I accidentally snapped the safety line and hit my head in the fall...

dialogues.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
dialogues.text: Was laid up in bed, my head all swathed in bandages, for three months before making a recovery. And even now, I still feel pretty dizzy...
